source_row.english: Divisive speech, the words of a mentally Afflicted state meant to split up others. Harsh speech is that which is unpleasant; Meaningless, really every afflicted. Others, every other afflicted type like Flattery for gain, a song, a show. Like too wrong commentaries. Coveting Wrong desire for another's wealth. Harmful intent, hating a living being; Mistaken view, the idea that neither virtue Nor non-virtue even exists.

spans.rationale: Established divisive-speech compound, without invented PHRA or MA children.
The people targeted by division; distinct from the later Others who hold another account.
The full verbal noun is exactly attested as split up. Its bound genitive remains outside; no syllable is detached.
Purpose marker expresses the intention to divide; the English purpose framing is meant to, not a second state-of-mind noun.
Whole afflicted-mind noun phrase owns the complete English phrase, excluding a. SEMS is not forced onto the unqualified word state while the mental sense is elsewhere.
The second source genitive links words to the afflicted state and owns this of.
Speech noun in the definition of divisive speech, not the later harsh-speech compound.
Complete established harsh-speech compound.
Unique strictly narrower speech member of the harsh-speech parent; the earlier standalone TSHIG/words is a separate occurrence.
Unique adjective member inside the same parent; source and English ranges are both strictly tighter.
Established negative adjective with exact glossary unpleasant; no positive pleasant member is extracted.
The second afflicted expression belongs to the broad definition of meaningless speech, not the opening capitalized Afflicted state.
Explicit universal quantifier owns the first every. The later every in the alternative account has no second KUN token.
KYAL PA is exactly attested as meaningless. KUN before it is the separate universal quantifier, not part of an invented KUN KYAL PA compound.
Intensive particle reinforces the classification and is rendered by really. Full NYID record supports emphatic/precisely/only function; the local prose359 repeats the emphatic explanation.
First GZHAN names those holding the alternative account; not the object of divisive speech.
Second GZHAN is the contrast with the previously named speech types. DE LAS remains distributed rather than sharing this same other word.
Bare afflicted expression in the alternative definition; type remains explanatory.
Established compound has the exact glossary flattery for gain; neither syllable independently owns for gain.
Exact song noun, excluding a.
Exact show noun, excluding a.
First comparison marker scopes flattery/song/show and is rendered before their list as like.
Established commentary compound; exclude wrong and the preceding Like too.
Bad/wrong qualifier belongs to commentaries, distinct from Wrong desire in the following definition.
Second comparison marker introduces the wrong-commentary example; too is reinforcement outside the claim.
Established coveting compound. No internal SEMS member fits inside the single English word.
Preserve the entire instrumental-inflected LOG PAS form; its wrong/improper qualification is rendered as the adjective Wrong. No detached final s or source normalization.
Owner of the wealth; exclude the possessive clitic and distinguish the earlier other speech type.
Wealth noun in the coveting definition, not the unrelated mistake sense.
Object relation for the desire, distinct from LA in the later hatred construction.
Direct desire/attachment sense of CHAGS; wrong remains separately qualified.
Established harmful-intent compound.
Unique harm qualifier inside the harmful-intent parent; the whole English adjective is retained, with no artificial affix split.
Unique intent member, attested in the complete SEMS record and local compound.
Established living-being compound, excluding a and with no invented life/having members.
Exact hating sense; the preceding LA object relation is absorbed by the direct-object English construction and is omitted.
Positive virtue noun in the denied pair, not an affirmative existence claim.
Complete non-virtue compound preserves its lexical negation, distinct from the shared existential denial MED.
Viewing/believing noun is locally rendered idea; exclude the article and the following propositional content.
Established mistaken-view compound identifies the concluding nonvirtue.
Unique mistaken qualifier, directly attested in the complete LOG PAR entry.
Unique view member inside the final compound; distinct from the earlier LTA BA/idea.

omissions.tib: ni occurrences; bound genitives; de las; dang between glu/zlos gar; gyi after wealth owner; la after sems can; final yin
omissions.reason: Topic/copular relations, bound grammar, comparison with earlier speech types and list punctuation are distributed in the terse English verse. No separate exponent or affirmative absence is sufficiently localized for a new null.

One source MED negates existence for both coordinated terms, while English distributes denial across neither/Nor and the positive verb exists. Do not map MED to exists or arbitrarily assign the shared negative pieces. DANG/Nor alone would conceal that shared negative contribution.

omissions.english: the; a; is that which is; second every; type; too; possessive clitic; even; that
omissions.reason: Articles, relative/copular framing, explanatory type/quantifier reinforcement and the existential denial frame remain outside the narrow lexical claims. The second every has no separate KUN source occurrence.
